title: 第15章 时光灌体融合时之种第16章 重返黑水城怒惩黑虎帮
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 那道画面涌入脑海的瞬间，苏余忘掉了呼吸。
他站在一片无尽的虚空之中。
脚下没有大地，头顶没有天空。
只有一条河——一条由无数银色光点组成的、从虚空尽头流淌而来的时间长河。
河水裹挟着他，向时间的上游倒流。
每倒流一息，他便看见一个时代。
他看见时族的诞生。
那时还没有天道，天地间只有一团混沌的祖炁。
祖炁分裂，化为万物，而其中一缕最精纯的时间祖炁凝聚成了一个古老的图腾——那是时族的始祖图腾，也是时王碑的前身。
最初的时族人从图腾中领悟了操控时序之法，他们能让一株树苗在一瞬间长成参天大树，也能让一块岩石在眨眼间风化成沙。
他们不修灵气，不炼肉身，只修一个“时”字。
他看见时族的辉煌。
他们建立了一座悬于九天的时之圣殿，殿中有一口时之泉，泉水倒映着过去未来一切因果。
时族人凭借时之泉的力量，成为了那个时代最强大的种族。
龙族向他们俯首，凤族为他们衔枝，连尚未成型的四方神兽都要在时之圣殿前跪拜行礼。
然后他看见了时族的狂妄。
他们不满足于操控时间，开始妄想窃取天道的时序之权。
他们建造了一座通天塔，塔尖直抵天道法则的核心，试图用自己的时间祖炁取代天道设立的天地时序。
苏余看见一个身穿金色长袍的时族族长站在通天塔顶端，张开双臂，朗声宣告：“从今日起，我时族为时序之主。
四季轮转由我族裁定，生老病死由我族分配。
天道当退，时族当立。”
然后天劫开始了。
不是一道一道落下的天劫，而是一场笼罩整个时之圣殿的金色雷暴。
雷霆如暴雨倾盆，每一道都精准地劈在一个时族人的头顶。
时族人试图用时之力抵挡，但他们惊恐地发现——天道改写了时间祖炁的规则。
原本温驯听话的时间祖炁忽然变得狂暴而贪婪，开始疯狂反噬操控它的时族人。
那些曾经挥手间能让时间倒流的强者，此刻连自己的时间都控制不住。
有人瞬间衰老成白骨，有人退化成了婴儿，有人在时间乱流中被撕成了碎片。
这就是时间债务的起源。
不是时族血脉自带的诅咒，而是天道在覆灭时族时亲手改写的规则——活着的时族必须向天道缴纳“时间税”，每一次动用时间之力都要以寿命为代价，欠得太多就要用命来还。
苏余看见时族最后一个族长在废墟上对着天空嘶吼，吼的不是求饶，不是诅咒，而是一句预言：“天道！你今日灭我时族，改写我血脉祖炁，断我传承之路！
content_en:
The moment that picture came into his mind, Su Yu forgot to breathe.
He stood in an endless void.
There is no earth beneath our feet and no sky above our heads.
There is only one river - a long river of time composed of countless silver points of light flowing from the end of the void.
The river hugged him and flowed backwards in time.
Every time he took a breath back, he saw an era.
He saw the birth of the Time Clan.
At that time, there was no way of heaven, and there was only a chaotic mass of ancestral energy between heaven and earth.
The ancestral Qi split and turned into all things, and one of the purest ancestral Qi of time condensed into an ancient totem - that is the ancestral totem of the Shi clan and the predecessor of the Shi Wang Monument.
The original Shi tribe people understood the method of controlling time sequence from the totem. They could make a sapling grow into a towering tree in an instant, and they could also make a rock turn into sand in the blink of an eye.
They do not cultivate spiritual energy or physical body, they only cultivate the word "Shi".
He saw the glory of the Shi clan.
They built a temple of time that hung in the sky. There was a spring of time in the temple, and the spring water reflected all the cause and effect of the past and the future.
The people of the Time relied on the power of the Fountain of Time to become the most powerful race of that era.
The dragon clan bowed to them, the phoenix clan held branches for them, and even the unformed divine beasts from all directions had to kneel down and salute in front of the Temple of Time.
Then he saw the arrogance of the Shi Clan.
Not content with manipulating time, they began to dream of stealing the power of time from heaven.
They built a Tower of Babel, with the spire reaching the core of the laws of heaven, and tried to use their own time ancestral energy to replace the time sequence of heaven and earth established by heaven.
Su Yu saw a Shi Clan leader wearing a golden robe standing at the top of the Babel Tower, spreading his arms and announcing loudly: "From today on, my Shi Clan is the Lord of Time.
The rotation of the four seasons is determined by our clan, and birth, old age, sickness and death are distributed by our clan.
The way of heaven must be withdrawn, and the clan must be established. "
Then the catastrophe began.
It was not a series of falling catastrophes, but a golden thunderstorm that enveloped the entire Temple of Time.
The thunder poured down like a torrential rain, each one hitting the head of a Shi tribesman accurately.
The people of the Time Tribe tried to use the power of Time to resist, but they were horrified to find that Heaven had rewritten the rules of the Time Ancestral Qi.
The originally docile and obedient Time Zuqi suddenly became violent and greedy, and began to crazily attack the people who controlled it.
Those strong men who could turn back time with a wave of their hands could not even control their own time now.
Some people instantly aged into bones, some degenerated into babies, and some were torn into pieces in the turbulent flow of time.
This is the origin of time debt.
It is not a curse inherent in the Time Clan's bloodline, but a rule rewritten by Tiandao when it destroyed the Time Clan - the living Time Clan must pay "time tax" to Tiandao. Every time the power of time is used, it will be at the cost of life. If you owe too much, you will have to use your life to pay back.
Su Yu saw the last clan leader of the Shi clan roaring at the sky on the ruins. What he shouted was not a plea for mercy or a curse, but a prophecy: "Heaven's way! You destroyed my Shi clan today, rewritten the ancestral energy of my blood, and cut off my inheritance path!"
